channel.title: Mari Cris Daily
channel.description: A personal journal of ordinary days.

item.title: Morning light, before the house is awake
item.description: The kettle, the window, and a few minutes that belong to no one else.

item.title: The Sunday table
item.description: A faded cloth, a late lunch, and the light moving across the room.

item.title: The quiet hour
item.description: An afternoon practice of not filling every soft minute.

item.title: Flowers for no reason
item.description: A jug of pale flowers on a day when nothing was being celebrated.

item.title: A letter to an ordinary Tuesday
item.description: A note asking the middle of the week to stay exactly what it is.

item.title: Notes while the rice cooks
item.description: Garlic, a wooden spoon, and the most honest room in the house.
